sources.took: NOTHING, and the licence is why.
sources.note: GitHub's classifier returns NOASSERTION for MIT + Commons Clause, so that is what is recorded here -- a guard that cries wolf on every run is a guard nobody reads. The human reading is in licenceHuman. The Commons Clause forbids redistributing 「the components themselves -- whether alone, in a bundle, or as a ported version」. Formae IS a component library a customer picks from and that we hand over, so their code may sit on our own marketing site and may NOT sit in the library we ship. Recorded so nobody takes it later without reading the licence.
